confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use Taipei price-index estimates close to the July 2026 pricing window. Accommodation estimates are holistic and place Taipei above the supplied Taiwanese comparison cities. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain; they use local beverage-index prices relative to draft beer and vary by venue.
comparable_city_reasoning: Taipei is Taiwan's larger capital market, so I estimate accommodation above the supplied prices for Kenting, Taichung, Tainan, and Hualien, with a larger premium for three-star rooms than for basic guesthouses.
